scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @kpi/backend" "npm run dev -w @kpi/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kpi/contracts && npm run build -w @kpi/backend && npm run build -w @kpi/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @kpi/backend && npm run test -w @kpi/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @kpi/contracts && npm run lint -w @kpi/backend && npm run lint -w @kpi/frontend
